info.name: Weavr Embedded Payment Run Step up API
info.description: Weavr Payment Run Plug-in API provides a simple and flexible way for Embedders to add payment execution capabilities in their application.

item.name: Issue a one-time password that can be used to step-up a token

header.description: A unique call reference generated by the caller that, taking into consideration the payload as well as the operation itself, helps avoid duplicate operations. Idempotency reference uniqueness is maintained for at least 24 hours.

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier for the channel.

request.description:
Initiates the step-up token process by sending an SMS with an one-time-password to a device belonging to the logged-in user that was previously enrolled through `/authentication_factors/otp/{channel}` endpoint.

This process is required for endpoints that require a step-up token to complete the call.

_Note that on the Sandbox Environment, text messages are not sent and the one-time-password is always \"123456\"._
